name: iCell
summary_zh: 旋轉動物、植物及細菌的 3D 細胞模型，點選細胞器查看名稱與功能。
summary_en: Explore animal, plant and bacterial cells in interactive 3D, with organelle labels and explanations.
access_zh: 免費；舊版 App，請確認裝置相容性

name: BioDigital Human
summary_zh: 分層觀察人體器官、系統與疾病模型，可用於解剖學和醫技基礎課複習。
summary_en: Interactive 3D human anatomy, physiology and condition models for medical science learning.
access_zh: 免費額度有限；進階內容訂閱制

name: Khan Academy
summary_zh: 透過影片、文章與測驗複習細胞、代謝、遺傳及生物化學基礎；亦涵蓋統計。
summary_en: Free videos, articles and exercises spanning biology, biochemistry, chemistry and statistics.
access_zh: 免費；主要課程以英文為主

name: iMolview / iMolview Lite
name_zh: 蛋白質與核酸立體結構
summary_zh: 讀取 PDB 蛋白質及 DNA 結構，旋轉與切換分子呈現方式；iOS 連結為 Lite 版。
summary_en: View and rotate PDB protein and DNA structures; the iOS link opens the Lite edition.
access_zh: 平台與版本功能、收費不同

name: Labster
summary_zh: 操作情境式虛擬實驗，涵蓋生命科學基礎概念與實驗步驟；須具授權帳號。
summary_en: Story-based virtual science lab simulations; an active institutional or purchased license is required.
access_zh: 需學校或個人購買使用權；平板體驗為主

name: Lab.Hacks
summary_zh: 包含 C1V1、摩爾濃度、Buffer 配製、PCR master mix、細胞計數及多重計時器。
summary_en: Laboratory dilution, molarity and buffer calculators, master mixes, counters and timers.
access_zh: 免費下載；部分廣告與內購

name: NEBtools
name_zh: PCR 與限制酶實驗助手
summary_zh: 限制酶查詢、雙酶切條件、NEB 專用引子 Tm 計算及核酸定量換算。
summary_en: NEB restriction enzyme lookups, double digests, primer Tm and nucleic-acid calculations.
access_zh: 免費；Tm 計算適用範圍請依 NEB 說明

name: Zotero
name_zh: 論文管理與 PDF 註記
summary_zh: 匯入論文 DOI、分類文獻、閱讀及註記 PDF；可與桌面版資料庫同步。
summary_en: Collect research literature, organize references, annotate PDFs and synchronize libraries.
access_zh: 免費；大量雲端附件空間需另評估

name: PDB Viewer: 3D Molecules
name_zh: 生物大分子資料庫檢視
summary_zh: 查詢與檢視 PDB 結構、AlphaFold 蛋白預測與小分子模型；適合課堂展示。
summary_en: Inspect experimental PDB structures, AlphaFold predictions and other molecular models in 3D.
access_zh: 新近推出；功能與資料來源須交叉查核

name: BiochemCity
summary_zh: 把代謝路徑化成 3D 城市道路，透過 150 多個生化反應小遊戲探索代謝網路。
summary_en: Navigate metabolic pathways as city streets and solve 150+ biochemical reaction mini-games.
access_zh: 免費下載；遊戲化代謝學習

name: Cell to Singularity
name_zh: 從細胞到文明的演化遊戲
summary_zh: 點擊式演化遊戲，從單細胞生命探索演化歷史、物種與未來科技。
summary_en: An incremental game tracing life from simple organisms through evolution and speculative futures.
access_zh: 免費下載；含廣告及內購

name: Plague Inc.
summary_zh: 策略模擬疾病傳播、傳染特徵與公共衛生應對，可作為討論傳播模型的引子。
summary_en: A pathogen-spread strategy game useful for discussing transmission, interventions and model assumptions.
access_zh: Android 含內購；iOS 為付費遊戲

name: Bio Inc. - Biomedical Plague
summary_zh: 以疾病、風險因子和人體系統為素材的策略遊戲，情節誇張，適合批判性討論。
summary_en: A stylized biomedical strategy game using diseases and risk factors across human organ systems.
access_zh: 免費下載；內購；疾病呈現屬遊戲設計

name: ChemLab: Chemistry & Molecules
name_zh: 分子拼圖與化學鍵挑戰
summary_zh: 拖放原子及化學鍵拼出指定分子，練習價鍵、官能基和分子結構。
summary_en: Build chemical structures by arranging atoms and bonds through progressive puzzle challenges.
access_zh: 免費下載；廣告／內購；偏化學基礎
